title: The Order at the Noodle Window
youtube_title: The Order at the Noodle Window | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A shy try, done kindly, is already courage.
summary: At a lantern walk along the evening lane, Anil feels shy about an order at the noodle window. Instead of pretending not to care, Anil tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Nana Ruth stays kind and does not push for a show.
